# Shipping options and delivery times

Northwind Outfitters ships within the contiguous United States. Standard shipping
takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch and costs 6 dollars. Standard shipping is
free when the merchandise subtotal after discounts is at least 75 dollars. Express
shipping takes 1 to 2 business days after dispatch and costs 15 dollars.

## Dispatch and tracking

Orders usually leave the warehouse within 2 business days. Delivery estimates do
not include that processing time, weekends or public holidays. A tracking link is
emailed after the carrier receives the parcel; the first tracking scan can take
24 hours to appear. Check spam if the dispatch email is missing.

Northwind does not offer international shipping, same-day delivery, or delivery to

# Contacting support and escalation

Northwind support operates Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Eastern Time, excluding
US public holidays. Send a message using the support form and include an order number
when the question concerns an order. The usual initial response target is 2 business
days; this is a target rather than a guaranteed resolution deadline.

## What to include

Describe the issue and the outcome requested. Attach photos for a damaged item and
the tracking number for a delivery problem. Never send a full card number, account
password or API key. Avoid opening duplicate tickets for the same issue because
support may need to merge them.

## Human review

Refund proposals above 80 dollars, uncertain eligibility, privacy requests, carrier
investigations and suspected fraud req

# Missing packages and stalled tracking

For a Northwind parcel marked delivered but missing, check the delivery address,
building reception, safe places around the door, and household members first.
Allow 48 hours after the delivered scan because some carriers scan early.

## Contact support

If the parcel is still missing after 48 hours, contact support with the order number
and tracking number. Support opens a carrier investigation. For tracking that has
not updated for 5 business days, contact support even if no delivered scan appears.
Northwind cannot guarantee a replacement or refund before investigating the shipment.

An estimated delivery date is not confirmation of a lost parcel. The agent should

# Cancelling an order

A Northwind order may be cancelled within one hour of purchase if it has not been
dispatched. Contact support immediately with your order number. Support must check
the current order status before confirming a cancellation; sending a request alone
does not guarantee that it succeeded.

## After dispatch

A shipped order cannot be cancelled or recalled. Receive the parcel and use the
returns process if the item is eligible. Do not promise a cancellation when tracking
already shows carrier acceptance. Cancellation and refund processing are separate
operations; any proposed mock refund in this demo still requires human approval.

Support cannot add products or change a size after checkout. If the order is still
eligible, request cancellation and place

eligible, request cancellation and place a new order yourself. A cancelled order is
not eligible for a second refund. Card authorization holds follow the payments policy.

# Size and color exchanges

Northwind does not process direct exchanges. If an unused item has its original
tags and is within the 30-day return window, start an authorized return and place
a separate order for the desired size or color. The new order uses current prices
and available stock; support cannot reserve stock while waiting for a return.

## Costs and exceptions

A change-of-mind return has the normal 5-dollar return postage deduction. Shipping
for the replacement purchase follows the shipping policy. A sale price from the
original purchase is not automatically transferred. If Northwind sent the wrong
size or color, report it under damaged and incorrect items instead; Northwind then
covers approved return postage.

# Contoso returns and refunds

Contoso Gear accepts unused products with original packaging within 60 calendar
days of delivery. This is a Contoso policy, not Northwind's 30-day policy. Contact
Contoso support for a return authorization before shipping the product. Authorized
Contoso change-of-mind return postage is free.

## Processing

Contoso inspects returned goods within 5 business days of arrival and then processes
an approved refund to the original payment method. Bank posting may take another
3 to 5 business days. Personalization and clearance products are excluded from
change-of-mind returns. Damaged items use Contoso's separate review procedure.

Report damaged or incorrect Contoso products within 14 calendar days of delivery.
Include the order number, photographs of the damage and a picture of the packaging.
Contoso support reviews the evidence before choosing a repair, replacement or

or obtain Contoso order information.

# Gift cards and gift returns

Northwind digital gift cards are emailed to the recipient after payment is confirmed.
They do not expire and are redeemable only at Northwind checkout. A remaining
balance stays on the card for a future purchase. Gift cards cannot be exchanged
for cash and cannot be used to buy another gift card.

## Returning a gift

An eligible gift return needs a gift receipt or the original order number and must
meet the normal unused-with-tags 30-day return requirement. The recipient receives
store credit; Northwind does not send the recipient a refund to somebody else's
card. The purchaser may request an original-payment refund through support instead.

## Lost gift emails

Ask support to resend the gift email after ownership is verified. Do not post a full
gift-card co



## Lost gift emails

Ask support to resend the gift email after ownership is verified. Do not post a full
gift-card code in a ticket. Support cannot reveal another customer's gift-card balance
or order details without verifying the requesting customer's access.
